title: Why You Feel Forced to Return Favours and Gifts
hook: Give someone a gift and they instantly owe you one.

narration.text: When you receive a gift or a compliment, you feel a strong urge to reciprocate.
This isn't just politeness; it is a fundamental social rule.
Our brains are wired to maintain balance in social exchanges.
It builds trust and cooperation, strengthening our community bonds.
Ignoring this impulse can make us feel uncomfortable or even guilty.
Understanding this helps us navigate social situations more effectively.
Tell me in the comments, what was the last gift you felt you had to reciprocate, and subscribe for more insights into human behaviour.

description: Ever wondered why you feel compelled to give back after receiving a gift or compliment? This video explains the powerful social rule behind reciprocity, a key mechanism in human interaction and community building. Discover why our brains are wired this way and how it impacts your daily life.
topic: Why you often feel a strong urge to reciprocate when someone gives you a gift or compliment. This is a common social rule.
